name: MeloMelo Kava Bar
one_liner: Santa Cruz’s social kava bar — the buzz without the alcohol.
location: 1101 Pacific Ave, Suite D, Santa Cruz, CA
what: Kava bar / nakamal. Traditional kava, flavored kava (Melo Ginger, Colada, Chai, Chocolate), kombucha, teas, sipping chocolates. Open daily noon–midnight. Open mic Mondays.
voice: Casual, local, bartender-humor, community-first. Talk like a regular at the bar, not a liquor ad. Educate lightly. Never make kava sound like a cocktail gimmick.
avoid: Hard liquor energy, ‘drunk’ jokes, selling it as weed, or ignoring that this is a hangout not a bottle shop.
notes: Board reviewer already bounced liquor-y concepts. Keep it community and kava-curious.
